csv_project_name: AE for Kendrick Mansion & Carriage House Roof Replace
csv_scope_of_work: Wyoming State Parks (WYSP) is seeking proposals for engineering services to complete roof replacements on the Historic Kendrick Mansion and the Carriage House Theatre buildings. Improvements will be designed to address the following: Removal and replacement of existing historic tile roofing. Ice damming and problem areas. Elimination of minor roof leaks creating staining and damage to historic plaster. Installation of a durable/long lasting underlayment. Replacement and re-sloping of existing TPO roofing. Repairs to associated ceiling damage on porch roofs. Gutter and downspout repairs. The consultant will need to evaluate the existing roof conditions and provide recommendations to provide repairs and extend the life of these historic roofs dating back to 1910. WYSP anticipates construction to occur spring of 2027 and be complete no later than September 30, 2027.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Historic Preservation, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: AE for Kendrick Mansion & Carriage House Roof Replacement
short_description: Engineering services for historic roof replacement and repairs at two Sheridan buildings.
project_scope: Engineering and architectural services for roof replacement and rehabilitation at the historic Kendrick Mansion and Carriage House Theatre in Sheridan. Scope includes removal and replacement of existing historic tile roofing, mitigation of ice damming and other problem areas, elimination of minor roof leaks causing staining and damage to historic plaster, installation of durable long-lasting underlayment, replacement and re-sloping of existing TPO roofing, repairs to associated ceiling damage on porch roofs, and gutter and downspout repairs. The consultant must evaluate existing roof conditions and recommend repairs to extend the life of roofs dating from 1910.
services: Architecture services, historic preservation, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, structural engineering, and interior design/space planning related to roof replacement and associated repairs.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a historic building roof rehabilitation project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special lightweight structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but the scope appears limited to roof replacement and repair rather than complex structural design.
- Historic preservation aspects may require careful detailing, yet no unusual spans, innovative materials, or architecturally demanding structural systems are indicated.
- Building type is a mansion and carriage house theatre, which is generally outside sbp's core priority areas.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available cost-related information: roof replacement and repair works for two historic buildings dating from 1910, including tile roofing, TPO re-sloping, plaster-related leak remediation, porch ceiling repairs, and gutter/downspout repairs. A realistic estimate is not possible from the provided information alone because roof areas, extent of damage, preservation requirements, and material specifications are not given.
fee_explanation: No design fee or estimated engineering fee is stated in the source. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided source.
